skill.displayName: PowPow CLI — PowPow 技能共享执行层：登录/发帖/建数字人/删帖（写操作默认预览，--confirm 才执行）

llm.summary: The skill is mostly coherent, but it needs review because a standalone image-upload command performs an authenticated remote upload without the dry-run/--confirm gate promised for write actions.

dimensions.detail: The skill stores a PowPow JWT in a per-user state directory and uses it for platform API calls; this is disclosed and proportionate, but it grants account-level action authority while active.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No dependency installation, tool wrapping, remote code retrieval, or startup persistence was found; the platform URL is pinned to https://global.powpow.online.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The top-level safety contract says all write operations are dry-run by default and require --confirm, but scripts/upload-image.js immediately POSTs the selected local image when invoked.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to the disclosed session file and generated local draft/preview/manifest files; logout removes the session file. Remote publishing, deletion, and digital-human creation are gated, except for standalone image upload.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The CLI purpose matches the included capabilities: login, compose drafts, publish posts, create digital humans, delete posts, upload images, and verify platform state.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the upload-image behavior before installing. Use this skill only if you trust PowPow with the account session and any images you explicitly pass to the CLI. Run login yourself, preview drafts first, use --confirm only after reviewing the action, avoid standalone upload-image unless you intend to upload that file, and run logout on shared machines.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Accepted as a narrow concern: the standalone upload-image command is a remote write and lacks the dry-run/--confirm behavior promised for writes.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted as the same concrete issue: scripts/upload-image.js validates a local image and immediately POSTs it with the stored bearer token.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded after inspection: the referenced scripts are present in the artifact and were reviewed directly.
[TM1] expected: Downgraded: delete-post is an expected JWT-scoped account action, previews before deletion without --confirm, and did not show evidence of bypassing that confirmation gate.
